nina_pm: Customer asked for a concise runway to support 7-year audit log retention under customer-controlled keys and searchable e‑discovery. Need options, acceptance tests, and a recommendation for a Q2 pilot.
carlos_sec: Two clear patterns: (1) export-only: monthly encrypted bundles pushed to customer storage + signed manifests + notarization; (2) searchable-hybrid: keep encrypted blobs + an encrypted searchable index (blind index) while keys live with customer or escrow. Export reduces our compliance surface.
vivian_legal: For SOW we need: custody definition (who has plaintext), evidence format, termination/export window, notarization obligations, e‑discovery cost allocation, and a clause on chain‑of‑custody integrity. Also whether customer can trigger legal_hold via API.
ravi_eng: Quick feasibility notes: export-only = snapshot worker + manifest signer + delivery confirmations. Searchable-hybrid = index pipeline, blind/index encryption, and escrow integration for KEK retrieval during restore. Hybrid is more infra work and increases audit controls.
ben_sre: Ops essentials: legal_hold toggle with immediate suspend, signed manifests with SHA256 lists, notarization (TSA or public ledger anchor), RTO for restores, and a test plan for periodic restore drills. Also suggest merkle proofs per-month for tamper-evidence.
amy_sales: Customer prefers hybrid for e‑discovery speed but is price-sensitive. We should propose export-first pilot + paid indexing/hybrid option. Need pricing bands.
carlos_sec: Security requirements to include in acceptance criteria: attestation token on key enrollment, envelope encryption with customer KEK for exports, proof that Redwood never holds KEK plaintext, and rotation/expiry policy for attestations.
nina_pm: Draft acceptance tests (short):
- monthly_export: each month a bundle delivered to customer bucket w/ signed manifest and notarized merkle root
- delivery_receipt: customer receipt persisted in Redwood for 10y
- merkle_verification: spot-check returns valid merkle proof for random object
- legal_hold: API toggles suspend + audit trail; expiry resumes only after manual release
- restore_drill: runbooked restore completed successfully in <=72h in 90% of drills
- search_verification (if hybrid): blind-index query returns expected hits w/o exposing KEK
carlos_sec: Add attestation test: when tenant registers BYOK, attestation token is verified and stored; any expired/invalid attestation blocks writes to retention bucket.
vivian_legal: Contract bullets to attach to SOW: retention_policy_id, custody_model options, delivery cadence (monthly), notarization method, termination_handoff window (30d), liability boundary for tampering (notarized proofs reduce contested liability), and cost allocation for storage/indexing/e-discovery.
ravi_eng: Rough effort & staging: export-only pilot = 3-5w with 0.5 FTE + ops runway; hybrid-search pilot = 8-12w with ~1.5 FTE + security audit. Indexing add-on + search UI extra.
ben_sre: Runbook skeleton items: CLI/API examples for hold set/unset, manifest verification steps, merkle proof verification snippet, manual export trigger flow, failure modes & playbook. We'll document escalation and SLAs.
amy_sales: Pricing approach: tier A (export-only) = storage + egress + notarization fee; tier B (indexed-export) = +search indexing per GB; tier C (hybrid BYOK in-place) = enterprise add-on with security addendum and audit pass-through. I'll draft bands for customer review.
nina_pm: Quick SLO proposals: monthly export success >= 99% within 48h of boundary; restore drills success >= 90% within 72h; manifest notarization confirmation within 24h. We can tighten after pilot.
carlos_sec: Operational guardrails: prefer export-first default; require customer to accept storage/egress costs for export model; for in-place retention require security addendum, additional audit controls, and dedicated onboarding checklist.
vivian_legal: Questions we must answer before sending SOW to customer: 1) Can customer initiate legal_hold via API? 2) Who pays for e-discovery? 3) What notarization provider(s) do we support? Let's finalize answers in draft.
ravi_eng: Action items & owners:
- nina_pm + carlos_sec: finalize acceptance criteria doc PR to /docs/retention-pilots by Wed EOD (owner: nina_pm)
- vivian_legal: draft SOW bullets & custody clause by Fri
- ravi_eng: prototype manifest format + merkle proof generator + cost estimate by next Tue
- ben_sre: runbook skeleton + restore drill checklist by next Tue
- amy_sales: pricing bands + customer proposal by Wed
- opsbot: created doc https://tiny.redwood/retention-anchoring-hybrid-proposal
nina_pm: I'll schedule 30m customer sync for Thu 10am PT and circulate the draft before the call. Keep replies short here. If blocked ping me directly :calendar:
